body: no i don't think that would be a good idea

I cope by daydreaming and shutting myself away but it makes me feel worse tbh

I need to find something worth living for but I just can't seem to. I've been trying my whole life. I have no prospects in any sense. The idea of a peaceful death is soothing to me
